events.text_en: Uông Liên Chu lashes the feuding boat families' boats together across the Nine-Bend River and will not cut the ropes until they swear to be one gate.
Lãng Đào's pilot rows a pig out to the eighth bend, and the water serpent lets the ferries through. The gate has fed it every spring since.
Lãng Đào's ferry master begins to charge Lạc Hà's boats a toll at the Ngư Ca landing that Tùng Đào never set.
When the Đào Sa landing burns, Thương Bạch Phàm cuts one ferry loose and poles it into the current with nine children aboard.
